name: status-bar
title: StatusBar
description: The thin bar at the bottom of an app or pane: one-line status items that truncate, buttons, a spacer, and live items announced politely.

manifest.name: status-bar
manifest.title: StatusBar
manifest.description: The thin bar at the bottom of an app or pane: one-line status items that truncate, buttons, a spacer, and live items announced politely.
manifest.usage: Use StatusBar at the bottom of the app shell or of a results pane for passive status: connection, row count, elapsed time, cursor position, encoding. Compose StatusBar (aria-label) > StatusBarItem / StatusBarButton, StatusBarSpacer, then the items for the end. Wrap item text in a <span> so it truncates, and put the full text in title. Mark the item that changes after an action (row count) live. For commands use Toolbar; for messages that need attention use Toast or Alert.

props.name: variant
props.description: default on the surface with a top border; accent filled with the accent solid.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render a <footer> instead of the <div>.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: role="group", size.control.xs high, text.caption; data-slot="status-bar", data-variant.

slots.name: item
slots.description: One line of status that truncates its <span>; data-slot="status-bar-item"; role="status" when live.

slots.name: spacer
slots.description: Takes the free space; data-slot="status-bar-spacer", aria-hidden.

parts.name: StatusBarItem
parts.description: Status text with an optional icon; live makes it a polite live region.

parts.name: StatusBarButton
parts.description: An item that does something when pressed.

parts.name: StatusBarSpacer
parts.description: Pushes the following items to the end.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over a button: color.interactive.hover (accent solid hover in the accent bar).

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on a button: an inset ring of ring.width in color.ring.

states.name: disabled
states.description: A button that cannot be pressed, at opacity.disabled.

accessibility: The bar is a role="group" named by aria-label; plain items are text in reading order and not focusable.
A live item is role="status" with aria-live="polite": a row count that changes when a query ends is announced without moving focus. Mark only the items that change after an action.
StatusBarButton is a native <button> in the tab order with a focus ring.
Truncated text keeps the full value in title; prefer short labels so nothing important is cut.
